dedupe_keys.name: juvenile chinook salmon 3d hydropower dam passage trajectories

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes acoustic-tag observations of juvenile Chinook salmon at Lower Granite and Lower Monumental hydropower dams through Dryad under CC0. The deposit lists hydrophone configurations, deployment records, more than five million cleaned detections, 403,900 calculated three-dimensional trajectories and assigned dam passage routes in CSV files. These observations can test fish-passage or hydro-structure agent models and help check how a simulated route choice relates to actual detections. Coverage concerns tagged juvenile fish released in the Snake River in summer 2013, with some receivers on the lower Columbia River. A caveat is that trajectories are reconstructed from acoustic detections, not continuous direct observation; receiver coverage, false-positive filtering and tag behaviour affect interpretation. The same Dryad package also contains HBET materials and MATLAB scripts. I read the own Dryad file list, DOI rights metadata and article Data Records without downloading tracks, running HBET or fitting a passage model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
